learning_outcomes.text: Understand basic structural and electronic properties of semiconductors associated with crystalline structure, energy bands and impurities.
Understand the physical principles of operation of significant semiconductor devices.
Knowledge of basic semiconductor growth and fabrication processes such as optical lithography, thermal and e-beam metal and dielectric deposition, wet and dry chemical etching.
General overview of modern developments in the rapidly expanding field of microelectronic semiconductor devices.
Be prepared to attend more specialized undergraduate or postgraduate courses on semiconductor physics and devices
Search for, analysis and synthesis of data and information, with the use of the necessary
Production of free, but structured, creative and inductive thinking

syllabus_topics: Material growth and basics of semiconductor device fabrication - photolithography
Energy bands – reciprocal lattice - Brillouin zone
Bandgaps in semiconductors – properties of conduction and valence bands – parabolic bands – holes
Density of states – bandgap engineering – quantum wells
Fermi statistics – intrinsic and extrinsic carrier concentrations – n and p type doping - Fermi energy level
Charge transport in semiconductors by diffusion and drift
P-N diodes – principles of operation – basic circuits with diodes
teaching_methods: Use of teleclass for communication and for uploading material related to the lectures
Support for learning by using multimedia (videos) and scientific web resources to display additional information when required
assessment_rules: Students are evaluated either by written final exam (100%) or by combination of written final exam (80%) and three homeworks (20%). The final exam is in Greek and includes problem solving and developing of topics. Oral examination is foreseen for students with learning difficulties. Students have the right to check and ask questions on their written exam material once the grading process is completed.
degree: Materials Science and Engineering — Πτυχίο Τμήματος Επιστήμης και Μηχανικής Υλικών (first cycle, 240 ECTS, curriculum ΕΜΥ)
